snapshot.text: Underfunded public system with poor access in rural areas and recurring epidemics. In early 2026 a mpox outbreak passed 400 confirmed cases across many districts, and the country trained a national SURGE team for health emergencies.

priorities.title: Mpox response
priorities.text: Mpox spread to 26 districts with over 400 confirmed cases and a first child death in March 2026.

priorities.title: Emergency response capacity
priorities.text: A national SURGE team was trained to respond to health emergencies.
